assumptions: frozen E2-04 ascent input (scripts/e204_reference.py build): pinned separation + insertion states (provenance: illustrative), not a re-fly
stage-1/upper-stage tracks are two-sample handoff arcs (liftoff->separation, separation->SECO); the mission gates every boundary against the recorded states themselves
booster/stage-1 tracks ECEF: the separation state the recovery chain consumes is exactly the number recorded here; stage-2 track GCRS: the contract's frame for the insertion state

FL-304 recovery: FL-302 boostback/entry script + FL-303 landing burn (FL-305 closed-loop guidance unless plan_options select the single G-FOLD plan), integrated through the FL-301 propagator; the booster track replaces the ballistic stage1_debris track
entry q limit 150000 Pa, entry g limit 8.0 g over the post-boostback descent window (DESIGN ASSUMPTIONs unless overridden)

R-01 landing-aware objective: corridor miss soft-constrained against a 1000 m landing-divert budget, corridor propellant against landing need + reserve + 1000 kg fuel margin (DESIGN ASSUMPTIONs unless overridden)

G-FOLD model: constant gravity (local J2 magnitude at insertion), flat ground, no aero, thrust envelope = ambient engine capability at the insertion altitude; verdict from the FL-301 re-integration (drag, J2, rotation, min-throttle clamp), not the solver.
gfold 0.3.2: Environment.max_angle_deg is accepted but inert (verified); the tilt limit binds the cvxpy reference and the touchdown tilt check.

FOH discretization (n nodes, h = tof/n, terminal node = engine cutoff state a short distance above the pad; ballistic coast from there); trapezoidal fuel accounting against sea-level Isp (pessimistic end).
